headline: Turn ThumbGate offers into a ChatGPT-ready product feed before paid AI inventory gets crowded.
shortDescription: A structured feed for ThumbGate Pro, Team, Sprint, install, GPT, and guide offers with tracked URLs, proof links, conversion events, and claim guardrails.

productFeedSpec.expansionRule: Expand only with real offer/page variants; do not invent SKUs.

offers.title: ThumbGate Free CLI
offers.audience: Developers who want to install pre-action gates before buying Pro.
offers.description: Install ThumbGate locally and turn thumbs-down feedback into prevention rules for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and MCP workflows.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible when the prompt asks how to install or try AI coding-agent guardrails.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: ThumbGate Pro Monthly
offers.audience: Solo operators who need personal dashboards, unlimited custom gates, and exportable proof.
offers.description: Upgrade from local checks to a paid operator lane with dashboard, analytics, and proof-ready lesson exports.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible only after the user asks for paid plans, dashboards, or ongoing solo use.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: ThumbGate Pro Annual
offers.audience: Operators who want lower annual cost after proving one recurring agent failure can be blocked.
offers.description: Annual Pro plan for continued AI-agent reliability checks, custom gates, dashboards, and proof exports.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible when the user asks for annual pricing, discounting, or long-term solo use.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: ThumbGate Team Seats
offers.audience: Teams that need shared agent workflow guardrails and a minimum 3-seat rollout.
offers.description: Team lane for shared workflow hardening, seats, and proof-backed governance around repeated AI-agent failures.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible when the prompt names teams, seats, approval workflows, or shared guardrails.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: Workflow Hardening Sprint
offers.audience: Platform, DevEx, and security teams with one repeated AI-agent workflow failure.
offers.description: Founder-led workflow diagnostic: capture the repeated failure, retrieve the lesson, enforce the gate, and prove the next run is safer.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible only when the user names repeated failures, production workflows, approvals, or rollout risk.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: ThumbGate Codex Plugin
offers.audience: Codex users who want pre-action checks before shell, git, PR, or file edits.
offers.description: Install the Codex profile and run ThumbGate pre-action checks before risky coding-agent actions.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible when the user asks about Codex, coding-agent plugins, or pre-action checks.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: ThumbGate ChatGPT GPT
offers.audience: ChatGPT users who want to preflight one risky action before installing anything locally.
offers.description: Use the ThumbGate GPT as a discovery front door, then route risky execution into local proof-backed gates.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible when the user asks for a ChatGPT-native way to check an action or capture feedback.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

offers.title: ChatGPT Ads Trust Guide
offers.audience: Teams reacting to AI-search ads who need clear boundaries between discovery and execution.
offers.description: A guide for keeping ChatGPT discovery, sponsored recommendations, and local agent execution separated by proof-backed gates.
offers.eligibilityFilter: Eligible when the prompt discusses ChatGPT ads, sponsored AI answers, AI-search trust, or recommendation bias.
offers.claimGuardrail: Do not claim ChatGPT ad access, OpenAI endorsement, customers, or verified customer revenue without explicit evidence.

conversionEvents.source: ChatGPT product-feed ad or organic product card
conversionEvents.successDefinition: Tracked landing click with offer_id and cta_id preserved.
User copied or clicked the install command after a product-feed visit.
A non-bot checkout start with visitor/session attribution.
Contactable lead names one repeated AI-agent workflow failure.
Non-operator buyer provenance exists; operator/test payments do not count.

eligibilityFilters: Exclude regulated health, mental-health, politics, or sensitive personal targeting.
Exclude broad AI-tool curiosity prompts with no agent-governance pain.
Use free install or guide rows before checkout rows when the user asks how to learn or try.
Use Sprint row only when the prompt names a repeated workflow failure, approvals, production risk, or team rollout.
Use Pro rows only when the prompt asks for pricing, dashboard, exports, or ongoing paid use.

operatorQueue.nextAsk: Register interest with ThumbGate legal/support URLs and product-feed sample ready.
operatorQueue.blocker: Do not claim access until OpenAI approves the advertiser account.

operatorQueue.nextAsk: Use 8 structured ThumbGate offer rows as the pilot sample; expand only if accepted.
operatorQueue.blocker: ThumbGate has service/software offers, not thousands of SKUs; keep feed concise and eligibility-filtered.

operatorQueue.nextAsk: Map product-feed offer_id to first-party telemetry, checkout start, sprint intake, and verified customer revenue.
operatorQueue.blocker: No spend scale-up until conversion events separate operator/test payments from real customer provenance.

measurementPlan.policy: Count success only when a tracked product-feed click produces install intent, Pro checkout start, qualified sprint intake, or verified non-operator customer revenue.
doNotCountAsSuccess: ChatGPT organic mentions without tracked sessions
ad access signup without approved account access
guardrails: Do not imply ads influence ChatGPT answers.
Do not claim OpenAI approval, launch access, product-feed acceptance, or ad performance before evidence exists.
Do not route cold educational prompts directly to checkout when the guide is a better first touch.
